calls.title: Geoffrey Lugli and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to enhance the workflow for podcast content packaging, emphasizing a blend of automation and human editorial control. Ashley Stirrup outlined a multi-step post-recording process that utilizes AI for topic extraction and narrative crafting, while Tanner Green introduced a content engine prototype aimed at integrating brand voice and episode hooks. Additionally, they tackled client engagement challenges, emphasizing the need for transparency and improved timelines for approvals. The conversation also touched on bundling podcast episodes into newsletters for better audience engagement and the importance of maintaining a consistent brand voice throughout various content types. The team committed to making necessary tool enhancements to facilitate these processes.
calls.keywords: Podcast Production, Content Workflow, AI Content Creation, Story Arc, Transcript Management, Social Media Clips
calls.action_items:
**Geoffrey Lugli**
Monitor appointment pipeline by being copied on booking emails as agreed to maintain internal visibility without reps seeing each other's schedules (00:20)
Develop internal section called “story arc” in Lovable for Ashley to input narrative direction to guide content creation (19:40)
Simplify clip/reel selection interface by limiting displayed fields to main topic, on-screen text setup, verbatim quote, and estimated duration for easier browsing (27:00)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide half-written blog post draft and story arc input for AI enrichment and final content generation in Lovable tool (17:40)
Use transcript downloads from the tool to run content through AI skill for clip topic identification and selection, then share selections for editing and publishing (20:55)

**Tanner Green**
Improve Lovable content workflow user interface focusing on clarity and user-friendliness, including adding the story arc input field and making transcripts downloadable and copyable (20:50)
Finalize edits on content workflows and reels generation module; make sure hooks and brand voice prompts align with Ashley’s workflow needs (08:45)
Adjust hook generation process to produce suitable social media hooks post-story arc creation, postponing running hooks until after story arc finalization (24:00)
